## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] I built the arm64 Release configuration.
- [ ] I tested relevant behaviour with a physical Sound Blaster X7, or the
      change does not affect hardware communication.
- [ ] I did not include Creative binaries, private frameworks, copyrighted
      artwork, confidential material, or credentials.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this work and agree to license it under the
      project's current licence.

## Hardware-facing changes

If this changes USB, HID, CoreAudio, or DSP communication, document the test
configuration, observed evidence, safety considerations, and rollback method.
